claims.claim: Adult human cardiomyocytes turn over at less than 1 percent per year.
claims.episode_span: Adult human cardiomyocytes turn over at less than 1 percent per year.
claims.source_title: Why doesn't the heart muscle regenerate after damage?
claims.supporting_quote: The turnover rate of adult human cardiomyocytes has been estimated to be less than 1% per year, a rate that precludes the repair of damage caused by myocardial infarction or chronic insults.

claims.claim: St. Jude researchers mapped 329 lentiviral integration sites in X-SCID gene therapy cells.
claims.episode_span: St. Jude researchers mapped 329 lentiviral integration sites and showed that inclusion of DNA insulators alters local gene expression, chromatin state, and three-dimensional genome contacts in ways that lower oncogenic potential.
claims.supporting_quote: mapped 329 integration sites in cells treated with the same lentiviral vector used in the X-SCID trial
